A person can have smallpox, scarlet fever, and measles but once each.

arxiv-1702-05712.title: MCBooster: a library for fast Monte Carlo generation of phase-space decays on massively parallel platforms.
arxiv-1702-05712.creator: A A Alves Júnior 1 and M D Sokoloff 2
arxiv-1702-05712.description: Abstract MCBooster is a header-only, C++11-compliant library that provides routines to generate and perform calculations on large samples of phase space Monte Carlo events. To achieve superior performance, MCBooster is capable to perform most of its calculations in parallel using CUDA- and OpenMP-enabled devices. MCBooster is built on top of the Thrust library and runs on Linux systems.

arxiv-2011-10275.title: Tetragonality mapping of martensite in a high-carbon steel by EBSD
arxiv-2011-10275.creator: Gert Nolze, Aimo Winkelmann, Grzegorz Cios, Tomasz Tokarski
arxiv-2011-10275.description: Abstract The locally varying tetragonality in martensite grains of a high-carbon steel (1.2 mass percent C) was resolved by electron backscatter diffraction (EBSD) with a spatial resolution in the order of 100 nm. Compared to spatially integrating X-ray diffraction, which yielded an average tetragonality of c / a = 1.05 c/a=1.

arxiv-2304-06004.title: Astrocytic gliotransmission as a pathway for stable stimulation of post-synaptic spiking: Implications for working memory footnoteinfo The work of M. Jafarian is supported by the Marie Skłodowska-Curie Fellowship, project ReWoMeN.
arxiv-2304-06004.creator: Valentin Würzbauer, Kerstin Lenk, Matin Jafarian
arxiv-2304-06004.description: Abstract The brain consists not only of neurons but also of non-neuronal cells, including astrocytes. Recent discoveries in neuroscience suggest that astrocytes directly regulate neuronal activity by releasing gliotransmitters such as glutamate. In this paper, we consider a biologically plausible mathematical model of a tripartite neuron-astrocyte network.

arxiv-2305-18015.title: On the Correspondence Between Monotonic Max-Sum GNNs and Datalog
arxiv-2305-18015.creator: David Tena Cucala, Bernardo Cuenca Grau, Boris Motik, Egor V. Kostylev
arxiv-2305-18015.description: Abstract Although there has been significant interest in applying machine learning techniques to structured data, the expressivity (i.e., a description of what can be learned) of such techniques is still poorly understood. In this paper, we study data transformations based on graph neural networks (GNNs).

arxiv-2409-03144.title: Geometrical Nonlinear Hall Effect Induced by Lorentz Force
arxiv-2409-03144.creator: Junjie Yao, Yizhou Liu, Wenhui Duan
arxiv-2409-03144.description: Abstract The recently discovered nonlinear Hall (NLH) effect arises either without external magnetic field (type-I) or with an in-plane magnetic field (type-II). In this work we propose a new type of geometrical nonlinear Hall effect with an out-of-plane magnetic field (type-III) induced by the combination of Lorentz force and anomalous electronic velocity.

arxiv-2502-03605.title: Accelerating OTA Circuit Design: Transistor Sizing Based on a Transformer Model and Precomputed Lookup Tables
arxiv-2502-03605.creator: Subhadip Ghosh, Endalk Y. Gebru, Chandramouli V. Kashyap, Ramesh Harjani, Sachin S. Sapatnekar
arxiv-2502-03605.description: Abstract Device sizing is crucial for meeting performance specifications in operational transconductance amplifiers (OTAs), and this work proposes an automated sizing framework based on a transformer model. The approach first leverages the driving-point signal flow graph (DP-SFG) to map an OTA circuit and its specifications into transformer-friendly sequential data.

arxiv-2505-16918.title: Scalable and Interpretable Contextual Bandits: A Literature Review and Retail Offer Prototype
arxiv-2505-16918.creator: Nikola Tanković, Robert Šajina
arxiv-2505-16918.description: Abstract This paper presents a concise review of Contextual Multi-Armed Bandit (CMAB) methods and introduces an experimental framework for scalable, interpretable offer selection, addressing the challenge of fast-changing offers. The approach models context at the product category level, allowing offers to span multiple categories and enabling knowledge transfer across similar offers. This improves learning efficiency and generalization in dynamic environments.

arxiv-2601-18142.title: Enhance the Safety in Reinforcement Learning by ADRC Lagrangian Methods
arxiv-2601-18142.creator: Mingxu Zhang, Huicheng Zhang, Jiaming Ji, Yaodong Yang, Ying Sun
arxiv-2601-18142.description: Abstract Safe reinforcement learning (Safe RL) seeks to maximize rewards while satisfying safety constraints, typically addressed through Lagrangian-based methods. However, existing approaches, including PID and classical Lagrangian methods, suffer from oscillations and frequent safety violations due to parameter sensitivity and inherent phase lag.

arxiv-2601-19134.title: Evaluating Nova 2.0 Lite model under Amazon’s Frontier Model Safety Framework
arxiv-2601-19134.creator: Satyapriya Krishna, Matteo Memelli, Tong Wang, Abhinav Mohanty, Claire O’Brien Rajkumar, Payal Motwani, Rahul Gupta, and Spyros Matsoukas Amazon Nova Responsible AI
arxiv-2601-19134.description: Abstract Amazon published its Frontier Model Safety Framework (FMSF) as part of the Paris AI summit, following which we presented a report on Amazon’s Premier model [ 7 ] . In this report, we present an evaluation of Nova 2.0 Lite. Nova 2.0 Lite was made generally available from amongst the Nova 2.

arxiv-2602-01442.title: The Gradient-Causal Gap: Why Gradient Importance Fails on Complex Tasks
arxiv-2602-01442.creator: Donald Ye

arxiv-2602-04131.title: Decoupling Time and Risk: Risk-Sensitive Reinforcement Learning with General Discounting
arxiv-2602-04131.creator: Mehrdad Moghimi, Anthony Coache, Hyejin Ku
arxiv-2602-04131.description: Abstract Distributional reinforcement learning (RL) is a powerful framework increasingly adopted in safety-critical domains for its ability to optimize risk-sensitive objectives. However, the role of the discount factor is often overlooked, as it is typically treated as a fixed parameter of the Markov decision process or tunable hyperparameter, with little consideration of its effect on the learned policy.

pmc-11354233.title: The Roles of Obesity and ASB4 in Preeclampsia Pathogenesis
pmc-11354233.creator: Yuye Wang, Rebecca Ssengonzi, W H Davin Townley-Tilson, Yukako Kayashima, Nobuyo Maeda-Smithies, Feng Li, Hironori Takahashi
pmc-11354233.description: Preeclampsia is a complex pregnancy-related hypertensive disorder which poses significant risks for both maternal and fetal health. Preeclampsia affects 5–8% of pregnancies in the United States, causing a significant public health and economic burden. Despite extensive research, the etiology and pathogenesis of preeclampsia remain elusive, but have been correlated with maternal conditions such as obesity.

pmc-11425720.title: Fabrication of Hybrid Epoxy Composites (Joint Compound Adhesive) for Aluminum Substrate Applications and Their Evaluation for Mechanical Properties
pmc-11425720.creator: Mohammad
pmc-11425720.description: This research endeavor deals with the development of an epoxy hybrid nanocomposite using aliphatic diglycidyl ether of a bisphenol A (DGEBA) epoxy matrix. The formulation used the stoichiometric ratio of the curing agent and incorporated nanopigments such as zirconium and silica, along with other microfillers.

pmc-12579004.title: Light-adaptive interfacial solar steam evaporation enhanced by dynamic water gating
pmc-12579004.creator: Jianfei Wu, Ziwei Cui, Dongfang Wu, Zheng Cao, JunYuan Zhang, Jiafu Qu, Jundie Hu, Jianzhang Li, Dan Tian, Yahui Cai
pmc-12579004.description: Freshwater scarcity is a critical global issue, exacerbated by water pollution. Solar-driven interfacial evaporation (SDIE) offers a promising solution due to its energy efficiency and environmental benefits. This study presents a light-driven adaptive interfacial solar steam evaporation system enhanced by dynamic water gating.

pmc-13037611.title: Sustainability and future outlook of the Philippine pig industry
pmc-13037611.creator: Md Sharifuzzaman, Hong-Seok Mun, Eddiemar B Lagua, Hae-Rang Park, Young-Hwa Kim, Md Kamrul Hasan, Jin-Gu Kang, Chul-Ju Yang
pmc-13037611.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The Philippines relies significantly on swine-related enterprises for food security and economic stability. The sector has faced numerous restraints in recent years and remains considerably distant from reaching the production target for domestic consumption. This study aims to identify the key drivers of the nation’s pork production in recent years, thereby enhancing our understanding of what is needed to make the industry sustainable in the future.

pmc-13182083.title: Screen time, physical activity, sleep, and depression risk in adolescents: an observational study based on the compositional isotemporal substitution model
pmc-13182083.creator: Hao Guo, Mengting Man, Zheng Hu, Yun Liu, Wen Chen, Sainan Wang, Xinmiao Tang, Anyi Geng, Wenhua Ruan, Wenzhuo Xu, Kele Jiang, Haiyan Shi, Jun Du, Guifang Jin, Xiaopeng Zhang, Zhihua Zhang
pmc-13182083.description: BackgroundAdolescent depression is linked to daily activities like screen use, physical activity, and sleep. Most studies examine these factors separately. This study investigates the relationship between screen time, physical activity, sleep, and depressive symptoms in adolescents using compositional isotemporal substitution models (CISM).MethodsA cross-sectional study collected data from 6,666 adolescents in Hefei, China, using self-administered questionnaires.

pmc-13347547.title: Parkinson's disease participant-led research: Towards neuroimaging-assisted deep brain stimulation programming
pmc-13347547.creator: Mark D McAuley, Alena A Ionova, Andreas Horn, Ethan Heming, Celestina A Onabajo, Madison M Solie, Sara A Stephenson, Susan E Boehnke
pmc-13347547.description: Deep brain stimulation (DBS) can improve Parkinson's disease symptoms; however, its effectiveness depends on selecting optimal settings. DBS parameter selection can be challenging, as objective metrics to guide the process are lacking. This n-of-1 study explored using functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) to guide DBS programming.

pmc-13486664.title: Multi-sensor observations and modeling of wave swash on a low-tide terrace beach
pmc-13486664.creator: Harold Diaz, Julien Boucharel, Patrick Marchesiello, Rafael Almar, Yves Soufflet, Rachid Benshila, Duong Hai Thuan, Nguyen Trung Viet, Luis Pedro Almeida
pmc-13486664.description: This study presents the first application of the non-hydrostatic CROCO model to simulate surf- and swash-zone hydrodynamics over a week-long field experiment, combining LiDAR, camera, and ADCP observations. This approach enables validation of cross-shore wave transformation and run-up dynamics, showing that CROCO reproduces dominant swash components and extreme run-up events.

pmc-13506847.title: Piezo2 in sensory neurons contributes to inflammation-induced bladder overactivity and is associated with the effects of electroacupuncture
pmc-13506847.creator: Xu Li, Junwei Hu, Yiyue Dong, Qian Zhou, Yuchen Ying, Zhilin Zhang, Qian Fan, Bingli Chen, Qi-Xiang Song, Wei L. Shen, Kangmin Tang, Yuelai Chen
pmc-13506847.description: ObjectivesTo assess the effects of varying doses of cyclophosphamide (CYP) on lower urinary tract function in rats, and to further investigate the role of Piezo2 in sensory neurons in a CYP-induced interstitial cystitis/bladder pain syndrome (IC/BPS) model and its potential as a therapeutic target for electroacupuncture (EA).

uslaw-usc-t25-s1521.title: 25 U.S.C. § 1521 — Indian Business Development Program; establishment; statement of purpose
uslaw-usc-t25-s1521.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t25-s1521.description: United States Code, Title 25 (Indians); Chapter 17 (Financing Economic Development Of Indians And Indian Organizations); Subchapter IV (Indian Business Grants). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. There is established within the Department of the Interior the Indian Business Development Program whose purpose is to stimulate and increase Indian entrepreneurship and employment by providing equity capital through nonreimbursable grants made by the Secretary.
